basic_info.main_problem: I constantly feel I must use all my time to prepare for university, to the point of neglecting self-care and relieving fatigue.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这种压力正在影响我的身心健康，于是寻求咨询，希望找到更平衡的方式在not牺牲自我照料的情况下准备大学。

core_beliefs: 我只有通过not断努力和成就才有价值

special_situations.event: Still faces college preparation tasks when feeling very tired
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not持续投入准备，就without法在大学取得成功，也without法成为Doctor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repression休息需求，延长Learning时间，牺牲睡眠与饮食以维持高强度准备
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该继续准备，not能停下来休息

special_situations.event: When family or friends invite participation in activities or interaction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not把时间都用在准备上，就意味着我not够努力，将来会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing与家庭活动，把时间全部投入到备考与准备
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果现在去社交就是not负责任，我会因此落后并失败

special_situations.event: Still planning or doing lengthy university preparation tasks before bedtime
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我停下来休息，就会被do not人超越，明天就会落后

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Stopping to rest now will make me fall behind

special_situations.event: 在休息或放松时产生强烈的内疚与Anxiety体验

special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用继续Learning来缓解内疚与Anxiety，避免面对放松带来的not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I feel guilty, which shows resting is wrong

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在学业上取得成功并Gaining recognition，同时也想被允许休息与被接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败、被negate，without法达到成为Doctor的目标

object_relations.object_representation: 可能not理解且带有高期待与评判的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 谈到他人（家人、社会）对成功的期待或成为Doctor的目标时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats external standards as the only correct self-requirement, believing deviation means failure
